newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George says rates under review.
newsitem.headline: St George says rates under review.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Thursday its interest rates were under review after the Reserve Bank of Australia cut official interest rates by 0.5 percentage points to 5.00 percent.
"We're very interested in the rate cut and our rates are under review," a St George Bank spokesman told Reuters.

Earlier, the Commonwealth Bank of Australia announced it would cut its key variable mortgage interest rate to 6.8 percent from 7.2 percent, but cut its prime rate for corporate borrowers by the full 0.5 percent to 8.45 percent.
Treasurer Peter Costello said today banks should pass on the full rate cut to business borrowers.
